---
title: "6.4 Typst built from R"
format: typst
execute:
  echo: false
---

````{r}
#| results: asis
best_animal <- "otters"
best_count <- 41

cat(sprintf('
```{=typst}
#rect(fill: rgb("#fff4e8"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d65a28")), inset: 10pt, radius: 4pt)[
  *%s* appear in *%d* titles this year, the most of any animal.
]
```
', best_animal, best_count))
````

<!--
NOTE: the chunk above is opened and closed with FOUR backticks. The string
contains a line of three backticks; with a three-backtick chunk, Quarto would
end the chunk there and fail with a parse error.
LIVE DEMO: change best_count to 55 and render again.
-->
